commit: feat(layout): improve flexLayout & fixed layout overlaps

truth.description: The new createLanguageNode returns nothing only for an empty language name, but its one caller renderRepoCard always passes Unspecified for a repo with no primary language, so such a repo now shows an Unspecified language that the card used to hide.

distractions.why: flexLayout reads a missing size as 0, so the third item sits one gap after the second, at 120 + 0 + 20 = 140.
